mentions.name: FaunaMap
mentions.description: This web/Android/iOS app lets nature enthusiasts see which birds, mammals, reptiles, and other wildlife can be expected at any location worldwide using the past 20 years of GBIF observation data. It features an interactive global sightings map color-coded to quickly spot recent rarities nearby, public birding hides from OSM plus a hotspots heatmap for trip planning, fast field logging of large numbers of observations, an Instagram-like feed where observations with images can be shared and interacted with, and personal species life lists (global, per country, and custom locations).
